summary: Master the art of advocacy and lobbying with our expert-led training course. Equip yourself with essential skills to make a real impact in your community.
lede: For public affairs practitioners, legal advisers, and communications leaders, lobbying training supports evidence-based, ethical policy engagement. Participants learn to assess legislative risk and stakeholder influence, prepare evidence-based briefs, and engage decision-makers in committee settings. They also practice coalition planning and campaign measurement, including tracking policy developments and outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for mid-to-senior public affairs practitioners, corporate legal advisors, and communications leaders responsible for shaping regulatory decisions and managing government relations. This course is designed for: Public Affairs Managers steering corporate government relations and legislative engagement programs. Government Relations Specialists advocating organizational policy positions before legislative committees and regulatory agencies. Policy Advocacy Directors leading public sector campaigns and non-profit policy initiatives. Regulatory Affairs Advisors evaluating statutory changes and drafting compliance response positions. Corporate Communications Leads aligning executive messaging with public affairs campaign goals. Trade Association Policy Analysts framing industry consensus positions and submitting regulatory responses. Non-Profit Advocacy Coordinators mobilizing grassroots networks and coalition partners for policy reform. Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Strategists integrating ESG metrics into government affairs agendas. Legislative Affairs Officers tracking parliamentary proceedings and briefing C-suite executives on statutory risks. External Relations Specialists managing multi-stakeholder partnerships and political risk exposure.
modules: Digital Public Affairs and Campaign Analytics
Advocacy Campaign Strategy and ROI Measurement
prerequisites: A laptop with internet connectivity and standard spreadsheet and word-processing software. Case study materials and framework templates are provided during the course.
